procedure_source:
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();p=root/'scripts/materialize_gmyhf_downloads.py';original=p.read_bytes();source=original.decode()
mutants=[('test60排除', '28979: "2026-10-24 审核：test60测试占位，保持排除",',''),
 ('待移除题排除','31195: "2026-10-24 审核：题名标记to remove，废弃题保持排除",',''),
 ('占位模板排除','31248: "2026-10-24 审核：占位模板题，保持排除",',''),
 ('绕过固定排除','if number in MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS:','if False:'),
 ('跳过后继续落盘','skip(number, "manual_exclusion", detail=MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS[number])\n            continue','skip(number, "manual_exclusion", detail=MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS[number])\n            pass'),
 ('首题排除后漏掉后续题','skip(number, "manual_exclusion", detail=MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS[number])\n            continue','skip(number, "manual_exclusion", detail=MANUAL_EXCLUSIONS[number])\n            break')]
results=[]
try:
 for label,old,new in mutants:
  assert source.count(old)==1,(label,source.count(old))
  mutated=source.replace(old,new);p.write_text(mutated)
  try:
   run=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_placeholder_exclusions'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
   assert run.returncode!=0,('变异未检出',label)
   assert 'SyntaxError' not in run.stderr and 'ImportError' not in run.stderr,('变异无效',label)
   results.append({'mutation':label,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(mutated.encode()).hexdigest()});print(label,'已检出',flush=True)
  finally:p.write_bytes(original)
finally:p.write_bytes(original)
report={'results':results,'restored_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),'procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(root/'collab/gmyhf-placeholder-exclusions-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
